title: Create a proposed decision record

title.description: Required. Human-readable document title. It must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

project.x-prompt: Which project does this decision affect?
project.description: Required. Documentation project namespace; may describe an existing or planned project and is normalized to a kebab-case identifier.

topics.description: Built-in topics or entries from megamono.json topics.extend. Unknown or duplicate topics are rejected before record creation.

references.description: Existing repository document IDs referenced by this record; duplicates are rejected.

externalReferences.description: External document references in namespace:identifier form; duplicates are rejected.

date.description: Record date in YYYY-MM-DD format; defaults to the current UTC date.

description: Create an internal proposed decision record. Topics must belong to the workspace vocabulary; the decision is not accepted automatically.
